title: oven-golden algerian lamb tagine
description: a flavorful and aromatic tagine dish made with lamb, spices, and a hint of mustard, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and tied with kitchen twine

instructions: season the lamb shoulder with salt and set aside.
heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in the raclette grill over medium-high heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
add the ground cumin, coriander, cinnamon powder, and mustard seeds, and cook for 1 minute.
add the lamb shoulder to the raclette grill and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
transfer the lamb shoulder to a large oven-safe dish and pour in the lamb broth.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
remove the lamb shoulder from the oven and let it cool slightly in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
shred the lamb shoulder with two forks and return it to the oven dish.
serve the oven-golden algerian lamb tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
